visual_brief.subject: Agents must interpret raw wet-lab evidence and controls rather than polished figures
verified_context: OpenAI and Ligo introduced BioBasicsBench with 100 expert-reviewed tasks built from gels, microscopy, instrument exports, sequencing files and protocol videos.
OpenAI reports 66.7% mean reward for GPT-6 Astra at xhigh reasoning versus 43.8% for GPT-5.6 Sol.
Published failure examples show errors in control interpretation, microscopy judgment and colony counting, so the benchmark does not establish reliable laboratory autonomy.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A single inspection lens must reconcile heterogeneous evidence before drawing a conclusion.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: Three distinct raw evidence forms sit on a restrained laboratory plane under one precise dark inspection lens, with terracotta rails separating observation from conclusion.

candidate_notes.A: Selected. One inspection lens, three distinct evidence forms and separated terracotta rails remain readable without pretending to be a scientific diagram.
candidate_notes.B: Constitution-compliant but visually busy; the evidence forms compete with the lens at thumbnail scale.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant but denser and more literal, reducing the restrained editorial character.

crop_review.article_desktop: The lens, three evidence forms and separating rails remain balanced across the wide hero.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered crop preserves the lens and all three evidence forms without clipping the focal relationship.
crop_review.thumbnail: The lens-over-evidence silhouette remains clear at 320px while fine texture becomes secondary.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected candidate carries the references' paper warmth, dark geometric focal mass and restrained terracotta accents. It is necessarily more object-rich than the DNS reference but keeps the agent-swarm reference's layered scientific depth; Golden Reference Fit is 87.
